fastest.name: NCPOR FASTEST Voyage
fastest.tag: Cape Town → Bharati → Maitri → Cape Town

explanation.summary: Canonical NCPOR Indian Antarctic Scientific Expedition route under FASTEST strategy.
explanation.environmentalProfile: Zero land collisions, active clearance from all 73 tracked icebergs.
